title: Explain the complete skill workflow
summary: A user unfamiliar with the tool can understand setup, initialization, staged implementation, review feedback, publication, landing, archival, and the files and commits created in the repository.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The manual explains how to initialize a review and exactly what initialization adds or changes locally.
The manual explains beginning, recording, committing, finalizing, validating, and replaying semantic stages.
The manual explains running the UI, submitting feedback, applying revisions, and approving resolutions.
The manual explains publication, PR-ready branch creation, merge expectations, and archival.
The manual clearly distinguishes ignored working state, stage commits, metadata commits, feedback state, branches, and archived artifacts.
